profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer offering strong object-oriented programming skills and progressive background as a lead and team contributor on projects. Coordinates effortlessly with various groups in requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation. Drives performance and functionality of front-end components, modules, features, and UIs for new and existing products. Leverages background spanning web, mobile, cloud-based, and gaming, combined with strong technical skill set and ability to rapidly learn new tools/technologies.

positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Pirates of the Caribbean: Isles of War - Real-time cross platform MMO RTS. 
- Involved in various core features development/improvements such as Schematics, Alliance Point Event, weapon firing system, and structure defensing system.
- Implemented various anti-cheating technique in FE.

Disney Hidden Worlds - Synced cross platform hidden object game
- Extended the rule based animation framework
- Fixed and clean up various cross platform UI issues

Gardens of Time – Award winning hidden object game
- Lead the FE development effort.
- Worked closely with cross-functional game team including product manager, QA, UI/UX designer
- Responsible for designing, implementing, and testing core components and game modules
- Responsible for identifying and resolving performance issues.
- Provided in-game sample and hands-on guidance to promote best practices.
- Implemented a testable UI framework, and reusable components, skin-able templates to improve workflow and reduce UI issues.
- Implemented a testable, skin-able, Model-View-ViewModel style jigsaw puzzle game module, memory matching game module that can be launched independent of the game.
- Optimized the isometric engine, iso object animation engine, path-finding engine, asset loading engine.
- Increased overall game performance from average 14fps to 20fps while adding 3x the amount of animation rendering on a fully occupied 50x50 isometric world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Management Console - an enterprise web app that manages Control4 devices remotely
and provides common functionalities and allows pluggable features
- Architected a pluggable architecture using RobotLegs framework. It communicates with web services through SOAP APIs.
- Developed dashboards, device management, device group management, and user management modules, RBAC as the common functionalities of management console.
- Implemented Remote Management and Energy related capabilities as plugins.
- Created a common UI library containing custom UI components, default skins and templates.
- Created a platform utility library containing common functionalities, interfaces, RobotLegs framework templates.
- Created a build script library to build web applications, modules for Flex using Ant.

Advantage (Management Console and Web service for EC-100 and ManagementConsole) - an enterprise app used by utility personnel to remotely manage our home energy management device, EC-100.
- Architected Management Console using PureMVC and BlazeDS from ground in 3 months.
- Involved in web service development, backporting features, testing, fixing bugs.
- Worked closely with UI/UX designers, backend server developers, and managers to improve look and feel and functionalities of the management console.
- Rapid prototyped a functional management console in 2 weeks for CEDIA 2010, Reliant Energy for promotion, business purposes.

EC-100 - an energy management device which provides homeowner their energy usage, billing information, and ability to opt-in to utility’s demand response, load control programs
- Involved in UI development, backporting features, testing, fixing bugs.
- Re-designed and enhanced the charting framework, streamlined and optimized the charting process to reduce the worst loading time from 30 seconds to 7 seconds.

positions.title: Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
RadiOnDemand - a management console used by Physicians, Dosimetrists and Medical Physicists for easing radiation therapy treatment process
- responsible for functionality design, development, integration,  and testing.
- worked with a team of contractors located in India.
- re-architected components into self encapsulated modules. 
- migrated AS2 animations to AS3 for Flex 3 integration.
- developed facility management modules, user management modules, in app message board, treatment progress modules.

positions.title: Software Engineer - UI
positions.description:
Skygrid Terminal - a web app which shows real-time news content. ( Adobe Flex, Cairngorm )
- Principle role of developing the terminal.
- worked closely with designers, backend server developers and managers to improve functionalities of the terminal.
- developed various features including front page, multitab streaming, advertisement integration, 3D rotation cube for showing advertisements in flash player 9, 3D rotation bar for showing stock prices in flash player 9 (flash player 9 has no notion of z axis), news streaming effect, welcome videos integration, 3rd party sharing integration. 

Skygrid - an iOS app which shows real-time news content.
- was one of the main developers, designed, developed,  and maintained components in MVC, event driven manner.
- developed in app advertisement storage, ad scheduling, 3rd party sharing integration, news streaming effect
